notes.title: Halloween Update Is Here!
notes.notes:
Happy Halloween, exterminators!

Trick or treat, the Kill It With Fire Halloween Update is here!  I hope you’re not afraid of the dark because the lights have gone out in the first three missions!  It’s your job to investigate, but don’t expect any clear answers!  Instead, you’ll find new objectives, new Arachno-gauntlets, and a new type of spider: the GHOST SPIDER!  A trio of new rewards exist for exterminators who brave the darkness.  Keep reading for more details!

[previewyoutube=C3sehHxuA7U;full][/previewyoutube]

First, let’s address the elephant in the room: the darkness.  With the exception of a certain level towards the end of the game,  Kill It With Fire is a bright and friendly game (well, aside from the spiders I guess). These missions ain’t like that:  they’re DARK dark.  Fortunately, all of your fire-based weapons now illuminate your surroundings!  I’ve also swapped the locations of the Flashlight and Protein Shake upgrades so the Flashlight is now the FIRST upgrade you find!  Don’t forget to use it!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36748212/63036f0e057f17811c1f393702f4e77a174c0eb3.png

Next, let’s talk spiders:  do they have souls?  It turns out the answer is YES.  Most spiders you kill while playing with Halloween Mode enabled will spawn a Ghost Spider (zombie spiders won’t because zombies don’t have souls - duh!).  Ghost spiders can’t be defeated the same way as regular spiders.  There is a way to defeat them, but you’ll need to find it for yourself!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36748212/d8bb20d82a345fd2af418ea802ba92fcae3fd0ea.png

In addition to the new Halloween content, I’ve also created a new system called Modifiers.  Most of these already existed (Spider Noir, Low Gravity, Goose Mode, etc) but I’ve re-organized them in a new menu so they’re much easier to manage.  A row of icons now display which modifiers you’ve enabled at a glance!  Handy!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36748212/00c1c80f64de6af16ac8844c9ea6dc4f3020f895.png

The modifiers menu is also how you enable the new Halloween mode!  It doesn’t cost any upgrade points, but you do need to complete the “regular” version of each mission first.  Also, Christmas has come early this year for exterminators that have been extra naughty - you can now enable Holiday Mode all year round for any mission that supports it!  It’s a Halloween miracle!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36748212/cfdc2ccf07d8ea5e316061a597cefc3e70d5342a.gif

So what do you get for braving the darkness?  There are three new rewards available (one per mission) for exterminators who complete EVERYTHING in each Halloween Mode mission.  First up is the Airhorn, a new piece of equipment.  Forget methodically searching for spiders - blast this bad boy to get the attention of every arachnid in a 50 mile radius!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36748212/0d2ec5b49557543a9dc3362c282f58baf25313ac.gif

Next is a new modifier - Australia Mode!  Don’t worry, it doesn’t make the game upside down (although I did consider that…) - it makes the spiders TWICE AS BIG!  Honestly, it’s a lot more terrifying than I expected.  If a double sized jumping spider flies at your face, you just might fall out of your seat.  You’ve been warned!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36748212/e58e48ca16e77903e7b286d5e2047b33fb75573a.png

Finally, there’s a new tracker upgrade: the Secret Sniffer Pro.  It requires both the S.P.I.D.A.R. and Secret Sniffer to use it, but it’s well worth the batteries.  With the Secret Sniffer Pro, you’ll see the location of secrets on your tracker’s radar screen!  It’s super handy for finding that last Omega File, battery, or blacklight clue you’ve been looking for!

One last thing - if you haven’t already grabbed Kill It With Fire now is a great time to pick it up!  From now until November 1st you can get it for 75% off!  If you’re just catching up with the game for the first time since launch, I’ve released a ton of other FREE content updates:


 Omega Files: new gear and secrets!
 Holiday Update: decorate a tree in each mission to get new equipment and upgrades
 Anniversary Update: a whole new level, new gear, and a massive puzzle!


That’s it for now, exterminators!  I hope you have fun with all of the new content!  Good luck and Happy Halloween!

Casey

notes.title: Anniversary Update is here!
notes.notes:
Rev up your engines, exterminators - the Anniversary Update is here!  It has been an amazing year for Kill It With Fire and Casey Donnellan Games, so I wanted to do something special for everyone who has joined me on this spider roasting journey.  

There’s an entire NEW LEVEL for you to rid of spiders along with new gear, upgrades, achievements, and the first ever Kill It With Fire “Community Event.”  Let’s break it down - if you’re worried about spoilers, stop reading now!

Last warning!

The new mission, “Down the Spider Hole” takes place just after “Domestic Duties” and allows you to explore the yard around the house from the first three missions.  As you may have guessed, it’s lousy with spiders.  Fortunately, with a new level comes new opportunities for spider murdering mayhem.  

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36748212/9059e99fced8d4d34d011fe995cfbd735a05b03b.gif

A new cheese puff flavor is on the scene: Best Buds Blueberry. “Ew, blueberry cheese puffs?” Well it turns out spiders have less discerning palettes.  Get one to chow down and they’ll become your new BFF.  These Spider Bros know your heart’s desire and will mercilessly pursue any spider they see.  And don’t worry - if you tire of your spider army you can always relieve them of duty...permanently.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36748212/a3432d567f379a2b08077e2f35b345c5fea1815e.gif

The next item you’ll find in the new mission is the Drone.  This was added during the “Omega Files” update last year and available during the epilogue mission, once you completed enough Arachno-Gauntlets.  It’s so much fun, though, I’ve decided to move it to earlier in the game.  You’re also gonna need it during the new mission to find everything…

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36748212/4701f3a44875072750ed3c84e5175f05ca9357ac.gif

All that lawn and nobody home to mow - it would be neighborly to “borrow” their Mower and tidy up. If some spiders get in the way...well, isn’t there an old saying about throwing rocks at birds?  This isn’t your grandpa’s old push mower - you’re getting a riding lawnmower with serious horsepower.  Still not enough speed?  Equip the NOS upgrade to go fast and make the spiders furious.  Once you’re done mowing the lawn, take her for a spin in the other missions!

That brings us to the Community Event.  I won’t get into specifics, even for people who want spoilers, but I will say a few things.  To get started, look for something NEW where the Drone was previously located.  After that, you’ll need to combine your clues with other Exterminators to find the answer. 
 Make sure you join the Discord - that’s where it’s all gonna happen!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36748212/f0beea99ddcc58c4ab8de032935f1def84b2690c.gif

Anything else new?  Duh!


 Added a trampoline
 Added spider holes
 Added a new Omega File
 Added “Asbestos Chitin” upgrade
 Added “Echolocator” tracker upgrade
 Added a ladder mechanic
 Revised mission selection menu visuals
 Added new camera angles for choosing save slot, viewing Omega Files
 Revised the Arachno-scope visual effect
 Fixed a bug where the drone spawned out of bounds when using Tiny Mode


Phew, that was a long one!  Before you go, make sure to follow me on Twitter and tell me how much you love the new update - I’m a glutton for positive feedback!   Maybe if you’re nice, I’ll give you some extra clues!!!

Casey Donnellan

notes.title: Anniversary Update Incoming!!!
notes.notes:
Hello exterminators!

It has been a while and I’ve been busy, busy, busy.  First, I’m excited to announce that I’ve spent most of 2021 (so far!) working on a completely new game. It’s an awesome, unique concept but very different from KIWF, so I hope some of you are willing to take a chance on it when the time comes!  I won’t say too much more, except that it won’t be ready this year, partly because…

Kill It With Fire is getting its biggest ever update on August 13th!

It’s hard to believe it’s been a year since KIWF launched, but here we are!  I’ve done a couple smaller updates - the Omega Files, the Holiday Update - but this is the BIG ONE.  How big?  We’re talking NEW LEVEL BIG.  

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36748212/0607ae58b4d2ba36d9b5aa051b4163b5cf9c1e43.png

“Down The Spider Hole” (a name that has multiple meanings...you’ll see...) takes place between the old 3rd and 4th missions (“Domestic Duties” and “Major Inconvenience”) and explores an environment you’ve seen but never visited - the backyard.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36748212/96a1493975c87a8ad6aefb37b0f7d825444b0710.png

Of course, with a new level comes a ton of other new stuff:  three types of equipment, a flavor, three upgrades, a spider type, achievements, objectives, batteries - the whole nine yards!  But that’s not all! This update brings something never before seen in KIWF - a community event!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36748212/fa667a3f9fe838ae64f73581b62b204c58d363af.png

This update contains a puzzle so huge, it’s going to take a whole army of exterminators to solve.  I don’t want to ruin the surprise so I won’t say too much more, but of all the new content this is what I’m most excited about.  If you haven’t done so already, take a moment to  join the official Kill It With Fire Discord if you want to participate!!!

That’s all for now, exterminators!  Mark your calendars for August 13th! Until then be sure to follow me on Twitter and let me know how excited you are for the new update!  

Yours truly,
Casey Donnellan

notes.title: Holiday Update and 40% Off!
notes.notes:
Happy holidays, spider hunters!

The year is almost over and I think we’re all ready to put this one behind us.  The trials and tribulations of 2020 aside, I’m excited that I was able to share Kill It With Fire with the world this year - and I hope you were excited to play it!  If you haven't picked it up yet, now is a great time - the game is 40% off!

As you know, the holiday season is upon us and a big Holiday Update has come to Kill It With Fire!  Even if you’ve been bad (nuke any towns lately?) you’re getting NINE gifts this year.  But it ain’t gonna be as simple as ripping off the wrapping paper.  Each mission now features a Christmas tree, but there’s one problem...no ornaments!  To receive each gift, you’ll need to hunt down the decorations and place them on the tree.

Before we talk about what Santa brought you, allow me to provide a few holiday tips and tricks.  First, the Secret Sniffer upgrade for the Spider Tracker DOES work on ornaments.  Second, to avoid extra trips back to the tree you can suck up ornaments using the vacuum, then spit them back out later.  Finally, if you’re having trouble finding an ornament don’t despair...try looking up!


*** SPOILERS AHEAD ***


*** SERIOUSLY, YOU'VE BEEN WARNED ***


*** TURN BACK NOW, IT'S YOUR LAST CHANCE ***


Now, let’s get down to the real Holiday business: GIFTS.  There’s nine in total and it doesn’t matter in what order you decorate the trees, you’ll always earn the gifts in the same order.  There’s two new pieces of equipment, three new upgrades, a new tracker upgrade, a new flavor, and two sets of bonus upgrade points (one regular and one for the tracker).  Let’s get into the details:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36748212/dc53ecce7f7b3e842b607935208ff53522be397c.gif


 Laser Sword: An elegant weapon for more civilized spider hunters. Burns on impact.
 Spider Noir: Lets you play in black and white
 Lucky Dice: They don’t do anything, but they look cool!
 Low Gravity: Reduces gravity for you, the spiders, and all physics objects!
 Radioactive Wasabi: Cheese Puff flavor that can transform spiders into Radioactive Spiders.
 Laser Gun: Fires projectiles that ricochet several times, potentially igniting whatever they hit.
 Gene Splicer: Randomizes which spiders appear in the mission, meaning potentially any spider can appear in any mission.


That wraps it up!  Have fun finding the ornaments and playing with the new toys.  If you have trouble finding them, I recommend hitting the Kill It With Fire Discord.  And, as always be sure to follow the game on Twitter or  Facebook.Good luck and happy holidays!!!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1179210/Kill_It_With_Fire/

Sincerely,

notes.title: Update #1: The Omega Files!
notes.notes:
Hello spider hunters!

Kill It With Fire 1.1  is now available and with it comes some pretty big changes to your favorite spider hunting simulator: new equipment, a new spider variant, special settings for arachnophobes, overhauled gamepad support, multiple save slots, and (of course!) the Omega Files!  Let’s break it down:

Omega Files

If you’ve already played KIWF you may have discovered some random manilla folders featuring the omega symbol, the last letter of the Greek alphabet.  Well, I hope you remember where you found them because now you can collect and read them to discover the answers to some of the game’s many mysteries.  For instance: why are there so many spiders? Where are all the people?  And what’s the deal with the cheese puffs?

Vacuum

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36748212/ce8711823b8b751b8f9b936bc0bf27ca9d796890.gif

Next, let’s talk equipment.  There are two new weapons added in the update.  The first is the vacuum.  You can use the vacuum to “suck up” just about anything laying around, including spiders.  Then you can switch the vacuums direction and shoot it all back out.  You can find the vacuum in “Domestic Duties”, appropriately enough.

Drone

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36748212/11133afa7a4c9ac314b6656ec6d2e5b3c3ede84b.gif

The second new weapon is a remote-controlled drone with a bomb strapped to it.  While you’re flying the drone, use its thermal vision camera to locate spiders, then swoop in and self-destruct.  The drone is available in “Consequences”.

Arachnophobia Settings

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36748212/50596b5cbe35704e9130d33b89cbab0d45b56048.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36748212/61d8d2698ce531ead08390606f54cdbc4bfeb5ec.png

Are you terrified of spiders?  If so, I have good news.  Kill It With Fire now features special options for people with arachnophobia.  Simply open the settings menu (from the main menu or in-game) and customize the options to your liking.  You can disable “scary spiders” to make them look more blobby and less spider-like as well as disable their SFX, the jumpscare sounds, and creepy music.  Please let me know whether or not these settings helped you to enjoy the game!  Are there any other settings you’d like to see? Accessibility is always an ongoing conversation and this is just a first step!

Supplyder

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36748212/6fd9ac872a14ebd7cbe3af4b9333ee726d83a772.gif

Next up is a new type of spider I like to call the “supplyder”.  It’s basically a spider with a supply crate strapped to its back.  When you damage the spider, the crate breaks open and ammo pops out.  Neat, huh?  You’ll start encountering supplyders in “Domestic Duties”, so keep your eyes peeled!

Other Cool Stuff

Do you have a friend or family member who wants to play the game, but can’t because you don’t want to erase your save file?  You’re in luck as KIWF now features three save slots!  Your original save automatically takes up the first slot.  To erase a slot, simply select it and choose Erase Save game from Settings -> General.  

The last major new item in v1.1 is improved gamepad support.  Kill It With Fire now features enhanced aim acceleration while using the gamepad.  Also, spider hitbox size has been increased while using the gamepad to make using weapons like the revolver, silenced pistol, and throwing stars much more feasible.  

[previewyoutube=fUca_tDtkTc;full][previewyoutube=fUca_tDtkTc;leftthumb][/previewyoutube][/previewyoutube]

Still reading?  Wow, you’re really dedicated to fighting the spider menace.  Here’s a handy bulleted list of the changes:

Major Features

 Omega Files: Your chance to unravel the twisted storyline is officially here. Collect the eight dossiers hidden throughout the game to discover info about the spiders’ origins.
 New Equipment: Vacuum, suck anything up, then spit it back out!
 New Equipment: Drone, remote controlled flying robot that can self destruct
 New Spider:  Supplyder - carries an ammo crate; bust it open and reload!
 Arachnophobia Settings
 Save Slots
 Enhanced Gamepad Support


Minor Bug Fixes

 Resolved an issue where equipment could be double-assigned by equipping/unequipping the Cargo Shorts upgrade.
 Resolved an issue where equipment could get stuck in an odd position by swapping while a melee weapon was being held back.
 Fixed an issue where the Yes/No buttons on the Refund Upgrade Points confirmation popup would never appear.
 Fixed an issue where hitting back/escape during the end of level confirmation popup would result in odd behavior.
 Resolved an issue where spiders would spawn in inaccessible locations (usually in the hedge maze) during levels 4 and 6.


Want to meet a community of like-minded spider exterminating enthusiasts?  Be sure to join the Kill It With Fire Discord. And, as always be sure to follow the game on Twitter or  Facebook.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1179210/Kill_It_With_Fire/

Sincerely,

notes.title: Patch #2
notes.notes:
Hey guys,

Patch #2 is now live.  Again, nothing major - just two small issues that were brought forward by community members. The version number for this patch is v1.0.18

First, completing the final Arachno-Gauntlet (in the Consequences mission) wasn't displaying as completed on the level select screen.  It didn't hurt anything, but I'm sure it was very frustrating to see! 
 That is now fixed, although you'll need to complete the gauntlet one more time to see it update.

Second, and a bit more significant, was the cursor sometimes leaving the game window when quickly clicking and dragging (like when rotating objects).  This issue was most common for users with multi-monitor setups, frequently switching tabs, or having certain other other programs open in the background that would "eat" your input.  It also only occurred in the "Borderless" windowed mode.  "The game now "secretly" locks the cursor to a fixed location, but only when the cursor is not being shown - problem solved!

notes.title: Patch #1
notes.notes:
Hello exterminators!

We're one day out from launch and it seems like most of you are having a great time with Kill It With Fire!  I haven't heard about any show-stopping issues so far (knock on wood!), but I did hear about one bug that I wanted to quickly address in a patch.  If you see v1.0.16 in the bottom left corner of your screen, you'll know you've got it!

For the curious, here's what was going on.  On the second level (Close Encounters), if you picked up all five batteries before collecting the S.P.I.D.A.R. tracker upgrade, you would complete the "Power Up" objective without having first discovered it.  That by itself is fine - it happens even more in other places (such as the "Fight Spider With Spider" objective in Major Inconvenience) so I've got code that automatically deletes the objective discovery pickup upon completion of that objective.  That's good, because it means you won't later discover a random, glowing sheet of paper that doesn't do anything.

Maybe you see where this is going - the S.P.I.D.A.R. upgrade is both an objective discovery pickup AND an upgrade, so when you picked up the 5th battery the game deleted the upgrade!  And, to make matters worse the whole thing was happening again when you reloaded the level, since we want to get rid of the objective discovery pickups you've already found.

I've only heard from one player that actually encountered the issue but it's possible there are more who just haven't said anything, so it seemed best to fix it ASAP!  Another issue that I discovered along the way (and I seriously doubt this has been discovered by ANYONE, but you never know!) is that if you never pick up the hairspray in First Contact but you do pick some up in a later level, you'll be unable to complete the "Find More Firepower" objective, since it was only listening for the player to discover new equipment, not find more ammo.  Of course, the game is called KILL IT WITH FIRE, so who in their right mind would skip grabbing the hairspray in the first level?!?!

That's all for today!  I'll just leave you guys with these awesome articles about the game.  They really made my day!

Fan Byte - Danielle Riendeau

Buried Treasure - John Walker
